title: Revenue Dashboard Impact — Breaking change to payment parser
description: A developer changes the return type of parse_amount() from int to Decimal. Regression Hunter traces this through DataHub lineage to the finance revenue dashboard and flags it as CRITICAL.

pr.author: dev-alice
pr.title: Refactor: use Decimal for payment amounts instead of int

binding.evidence: AST-extracted SQL reference: SELECT amount FROM finance.payment_events

risk_assessment.policy_floor_reason: Breaking change with authoritative path to regulated/payment asset and no relevant regression test

affected_assets.impact: payment amount may be parsed incorrectly due to type change
aggregated totals may differ due to Decimal rounding
revenue dashboard may display incorrect totals

recommended_tests.title: Test parse_amount with negative values
recommended_tests.body: Add test case for negative payment amounts to ensure parser handles them correctly.

recommended_tests.title: Test payment summary aggregation with Decimal
recommended_tests.body: Verify that daily summary aggregation produces same results with Decimal as with int.
